mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_educl_term WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.id, t.school_id, s.school_name, t.term_name, t.term_code, t.school_year, t.total_weeks, t.term_type, t.start_date, t.end_date, u.actual_name AS createUser, t.create_time, t.term_status FROM t_educl_term t LEFT JOIN t_school_manage s ON s.id = t.school_id LEFT JOIN t_base_user u ON u.id = t.create_user
t.is_valid = 1
AND t.school_id = #{query.schoolId}
AND t.term_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.termName}, '%')
AND t.term_type = #{query.termType}
AND t.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE()
AND t.start_date <= CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.school_id, s.school_name, t.term_name, t.term_code, t.school_year, t.term_type, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.total_weeks, t.term_status, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.term_status FROM t_educl_term t LEFT JOIN t_school_manage s ON s.id = t.school_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_valid = 1
